title: Chehardy Sherman Williams Recognized in 2025 "Best Law Firms in the United States®" List | User | ridgwayrecord.com
text:
Chehardy Sherman Williams is proud to announce its inclusion in the 2025 edition of the “Best Law Firms in the United States®,” a respected annual ranking that recognizes firms across the nation for exemplary legal knowledge, consistent client satisfaction, and noteworthy industry expertise. This distinction reflects the firm’s ongoing commitment to excellence and underscores the reputation that Chehardy Sherman Williams in Metairie has established as a trusted legal resource in the Greater New Orleans community and beyond.
The “Best Law Firms” evaluation process relies on combined insights from clients, peers, and law firm leaders, ensuring a data-driven approach that identifies only the most outstanding practices. Each firm considered for this honor must have at least one attorney recognized in the latest edition of “The Best Lawyers in America®.” Chehardy Sherman Williams celebrated 14 of its attorneys in the 2024 edition of “The Best Lawyers in America®” and “Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch® in America.”
“We are deeply grateful for the confidence our clients place in us,” said Co-Managing Partner David R. Sherman. “Their feedback, together with the recommendations from our industry peers, has once again confirmed our commitment to excellence.”
This new “Best Law Firms” accolade further highlights Chehardy Sherman Williams’ dedication to delivering top-tier legal services. With decades of collective legal experience, Chehardy Sherman Williams strives to offer personalized solutions that address each client’s unique goals. The firm’s diverse practice areas span more than ten key legal fields, including personal injury, estate planning, taxation, business and corporate law, healthcare, and more. This broad expertise allows clients — individuals to large organizations — to tap into a robust range of legal counsel.
Chehardy Sherman Williams’ attorneys bring in-depth knowledge of the legal system and stand ready to advocate in parish, state, and federal courts within Louisiana and across the country. Their commitment to upholding the highest standards of the justice system drives them to protect clients’ rights in even the most complex cases. Over the years, this dedication to results, service, and integrity has earned Chehardy Sherman Williams a host of local and national accolades.
At the forefront of litigation strategy at Chehardy Sherman Williams is The Trial Team, directed by nationally recognized litigator James M. Williams. Esteemed by colleagues and clients for his ability to enter a case at any stage and deliver remarkable results, Mr. Williams is often engaged as “rescue counsel” in crucial, high-stakes legal battles. Whether representing large corporate clients seeking seasoned advocacy or helping individuals with life-altering personal injury claims, he and his team bring a depth of experience beyond standard trial services.
Leveraging an in-depth understanding of courtroom tactics — honed through trials across the United States and internationally — Mr. Williams approaches each case with a thorough, strategic mindset. He has established an impressive track record of victories by assembling a specialized team equipped with cutting-edge techniques, consistently achieving favorable outcomes in high-dollar disputes. As the Head of Litigation at Chehardy Sherman Williams, Mr. Williams is known for turning complex litigation into winning results, exemplifying the firm’s commitment to delivering top-notch representation to every client.
For more information about this New Orleans law firm, visit https://chehardy.com/ or call (504) 833-5600.
About Chehardy Sherman Williams:
Chehardy Sherman Williams is a leading law firm based in Metro New Orleans, Louisiana, with a team of experienced attorneys serving clients in numerous practice areas. Committed to delivering exceptional counsel and personalized solutions, the firm has built a reputation for professionalism, dedication, and proven success. For more information, please contact Chehardy Sherman Williams.
